findings.evidence: mypy backend reports 0 issues in 659 files, while strict import traversal from two V5.2.4 files reports 33 errors in 15 imported test/support files.
findings.root_cause: The historical debt statement omitted the invocation scope and can be mistaken for backend debt.
findings.impact: Ambiguous quality gate and misleading baseline reporting.
findings.remediation_scope: Document one canonical backend check and one explicit calibration-support check.
findings.test_strategy: Run both commands cache-disabled and assert their reported scopes.

findings.evidence: Two union-attr and two arg-type errors remain after fail-closed lookup checks.
findings.root_cause: _configuration_error is annotated as returning None rather than NoReturn, so Optional values are not narrowed.
findings.impact: Static proof does not match the intended fail-closed control flow.
findings.remediation_scope: Typing-only annotation or equivalent explicit narrowing in the test provider support.
findings.test_strategy: Targeted mypy plus existing Anthropic scorer unit tests.

findings.evidence: Four arg-type errors pass tuple[str, ...] where CriterionOrdering requires tuple[str, str, str].
findings.root_cause: Dynamic comprehensions lose fixed cardinality information.
findings.impact: The three-tier ordering invariant is runtime-only rather than statically demonstrated.
findings.remediation_scope: Centralize or explicitly type the three-anchor construction without changing corpus bytes.
findings.test_strategy: Targeted mypy and corpus checksum/non-regression tests.

findings.evidence: One assignment and six attr-defined errors cascade in render_alignment_matrix.
findings.root_cause: The local name item is reused for CriterionDefectAlignment and CarryForwardEvidence loops.
findings.impact: Seven errors obscure the actual type safety of a deterministic renderer.
findings.remediation_scope: Rename loop variables only, preserving rendered bytes.
findings.test_strategy: Targeted mypy and byte-identical renderer/hash assertions.

findings.evidence: Four operator errors repeat comparisons against Decimal | None after an error helper call.
findings.root_cause: Duplicated fail-closed helpers do not expose non-returning control flow to mypy.
findings.impact: Budget guard typing is noisy in two historical plan generations.
findings.remediation_scope: Align non-returning helper typing while preserving versioned cost identities.
findings.test_strategy: Targeted mypy and exact pricing/budget checksum tests.

findings.evidence: ObservationField receives object instead of the declared Observation value union.
findings.root_cause: A heterogeneous values tuple is inferred as object before zip construction.
findings.impact: Calibration observation serialization lacks a complete static proof.
findings.remediation_scope: Narrow the local tuple/sequence type without altering serialization.
findings.test_strategy: Targeted mypy plus protocol serialization hash tests.

findings.evidence: Mypy reports ten redundant casts and one unused ignore across V4/V5 helpers and Anthropic transport.
findings.root_cause: Annotations improved while historical suppressions/casts remained.
findings.impact: Noise hides material errors and increases maintenance cost.
findings.remediation_scope: Remove only statically proven redundant typing scaffolding.
findings.test_strategy: Targeted mypy and unchanged artifact/checksum tests where relevant.

findings.evidence: A V51MiniPilotCallSpec is assigned to a local inferred as V51MicroCanarySpec.
findings.root_cause: Two identity branches reuse one local variable across distinct dataclasses.
findings.impact: Carry-forward identity construction is not statically closed.
findings.remediation_scope: Use a common protocol/union or distinct locals without changing identities.
findings.test_strategy: Targeted mypy and carry-forward SHA assertions.

findings.evidence: Thirteen modules expose 344 Python files, but 339 are __init__.py and the five implementation files all belong to resource_library.
findings.root_cause: Canonical module topology was scaffolded ahead of use-case implementation.
findings.impact: Package presence can be confused with implemented Domain/Application behavior.
findings.remediation_scope: Classify each structural module as planned, required, or removable before implementation/removal.
findings.test_strategy: Architecture inventory plus owner-approved capability/use-case mapping.

findings.evidence: Rule authority spans 98 top-level phase documents, 36 phase folders, 67 ADRs, runtime policies and 50 calibration helpers.
findings.root_cause: Versioned delivery accumulated several legitimate but overlapping authority layers.
findings.impact: Readers may select a historical statement instead of the latest canonical rule.
findings.remediation_scope: Build an authority index with supersedes/retained-as-evidence relationships.
findings.test_strategy: Link and identity audit; no semantic rewriting before owner review.

findings.evidence: 172 enum classes are distributed across 89 files; no exact duplicate class name was found.
findings.root_cause: UNKNOWN
findings.impact: Semantically overlapping status vocabularies may diverge despite distinct class names.
findings.remediation_scope: Compare values and transitions semantically; retain bounded-context distinctions.
findings.test_strategy: Automated enum-value matrix plus owner review of cross-context equivalence.

findings.evidence: 156 validator definitions include 16 duplicate-name groups and 50 definitions within those groups.
findings.root_cause: Local fail-closed validation was favored over shared abstractions across bounded contexts.
findings.impact: Equivalent-looking rules may drift; premature sharing could also erase domain differences.
findings.remediation_scope: Compare semantics of repeated names before any extraction.
findings.test_strategy: Behavioral equivalence matrix and boundary tests per context.

findings.evidence: The API package contains only a structural docstring; no /api/v2 router or endpoint exists.
findings.root_cause: Phase 8 defined a projected contract while later work materialized only Application/SQLite paths.
findings.impact: API-to-Application traceability cannot be executed or verified.
findings.remediation_scope: Recover/approve the authoritative OpenAPI contract before endpoint implementation.
findings.test_strategy: Contract tests against approved OpenAPI and inbound use cases.

findings.evidence: Fifty calibration helpers preserve multiple generations of runners, parsers, gates and call plans.
findings.root_cause: Audit lineage and live remediation were added version by version.
findings.impact: Maintenance and accidental selection of an obsolete runner become harder.
findings.remediation_scope: Classify immutable evidence versus active reusable components before consolidation.
findings.test_strategy: Identity/checksum inventory and replay-free offline compatibility tests.

findings.evidence: The Anthropic SDK transport and scorer used by calibration live runs are housed under tests, unlike OpenAI outbound adapters under backend.
findings.root_cause: Anthropic was introduced as calibration-only support rather than a runtime provider route.
findings.impact: Production/support boundaries and dependency ownership are ambiguous.
findings.remediation_scope: Decide whether the code remains immutable test support or becomes an outbound adapter; do not change routes implicitly.
findings.test_strategy: Architecture import tests and provider-offline unit tests.

findings.evidence: Two full pairwise parser/adapter implementations coexist after successive output-bound fixes.
findings.root_cause: Versioned identities were preserved for audit and one-shot authorization.
findings.impact: Future fixes can land in one version and not the other.
findings.remediation_scope: Separate immutable identity fixtures from one active parser only after closure evidence is protected.
findings.test_strategy: Golden hashes, boundary vectors and semantic invariants across both versions.

findings.evidence: Only Resource Library exposes a concrete module use case and inbound Application bridge.
findings.root_cause: Implementation proceeded vertically for SCN-01 while other canonical modules remained structural.
findings.impact: Declared capability/module topology exceeds executable Application coverage.
findings.remediation_scope: Create a capability-to-use-case coverage decision before adding handlers.
findings.test_strategy: Architecture coverage matrix and one vertical contract test per approved use case.

findings.evidence: The repository versions one corrective migration but not the initial DDL for the authenticated 98-table canonical seed.
findings.root_cause: The binary seed is intentionally external and immutable.
findings.impact: Offline schema traceability cannot prove all columns, enums and constraints from repository files alone.
findings.remediation_scope: Decide whether to version a non-runtime schema snapshot/checksum inventory without adding the database binary.
findings.test_strategy: Read-only introspection of the authorized seed compared with a generated schema manifest.

findings.evidence: Semantic index, operation marker and migration ledger tables are created by inline DDL outside database/migrations.
findings.root_cause: Technical schemas have independent lifecycle/ownership from the business seed.
findings.impact: Schema inventory and migration governance are split across code and SQL files.
findings.remediation_scope: Document or centralize technical DDL ownership without merging business and derived schemas blindly.
findings.test_strategy: Fresh-database schema snapshot and idempotent bootstrap tests.

findings.evidence: Nine stores expose generic dict[str, object] records; only Resource Library has a typed module mapper.
findings.root_cause: Phase 7 established generic adapter primitives before most Domain/Application modules were implemented.
findings.impact: Column/name/type drift is detected late for eight store families.
findings.remediation_scope: Introduce typed mappings only alongside approved module use cases.
findings.test_strategy: Schema-to-record contract tests and real SQLite gates per approved store.

findings.evidence: The tracked JSON file is the sole inspected text file without a final LF.
findings.root_cause: Historical generated report formatting.
findings.impact: Violates the repository LF convention and creates tooling noise.
findings.remediation_scope: EOF-only normalization in a dedicated lot with semantic hash accounting.
findings.test_strategy: Byte diff proving only one LF addition and JSON parse equivalence.

findings.evidence: Seven tracked Markdown files end with a blank line and are covered by a path-specific .gitattributes exception.
findings.root_cause: Byte-approved immutable evidence was explicitly exempted.
findings.impact: No active violation; exception adds maintenance context.
findings.remediation_scope: None unless an owner-approved documentary rebind is requested.
findings.test_strategy: Retain existing byte hashes and .gitattributes scope test.

findings.evidence: The two files are byte-identical.
findings.root_cause: Successive inconclusive execution packages reused the same closure-readiness statement.
findings.impact: Content duplication can be mistaken for an orphan, but may be required audit evidence.
findings.remediation_scope: Record lineage; remove nothing unless manifest and audit requirements allow it.
findings.test_strategy: Manifest/hash and supersession audit.

findings.evidence: 747 ignored artifact files and 3064 ignored temporary files are present; three pytest directories emit access-denied warnings.
findings.root_cause: Accumulated local audit/test runs.
findings.impact: Disk usage, noisy inventories and local permission friction; Git remains clean.
findings.remediation_scope: Prepare an exact, recoverability-aware local cleanup plan; deletion requires separate authorization.
findings.test_strategy: Dry-run inventory and post-cleanup git status; no recursive deletion in this audit.

findings.evidence: All 421 entries have valid format, exist and match their SHA-256.
findings.root_cause: No defect observed.
findings.impact: Positive integrity baseline.
findings.remediation_scope: None.
findings.test_strategy: Repeat manifest verification in future freeze/closure lots.

findings.evidence: No module or agent-runtime direct SQL/provider import was found; all eight sqlite3 imports are outbound adapters and SDK OpenAI imports remain outbound.
findings.root_cause: No defect observed; architecture boundaries are enforced by structure and fitness tests.
findings.impact: Positive boundary baseline; Anthropic test-support placement is tracked separately as ARC-003.
findings.remediation_scope: None in 12.17.1.
findings.test_strategy: Retain architecture import fitness tests.
